description: Benchmark registry of wrmodes 1.0 (CONVENTIONS.md section 9). One entry per benchmark: what it checks, the reference and its type, the data file, the tolerance and the test or script that applies it. Created by WP7 (wave 1). status: 'reference ready' = reference data and comparison exist, waiting for the implementation; 'waiting for data' = needs L1 or COMSOL output; 'self-check' = validates a WP7 reference itself.

entries.component: WP7 global-ODE line reference
entries.card: WP7
entries.reference: wrmodes 0.1 transfer-matrix solver (atol 1e-10, error_control='full'), product of segment transfer matrices
entries.tolerance: 1e-9 of input power, every output mode (WP7 acceptance)

entries.component: WP1 Line (Straight + SmoothBend, H plane)
entries.card: WP1 acceptance: WP7's global-ODE reference for three lines
entries.reference: WP7 global-ODE reference (benchmarks/validation_v1/ref_line.py), line 'same-plane', 20/40/60/90 GHz
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 of input power for every output mode (|S|^2 of S11, S21, S12, S22)

entries.component: WP1 Line with FrameChange (H and E bends)
entries.card: WP1 acceptance: WP7's global-ODE reference for three lines
entries.reference: WP7 global-ODE reference with independently derived frame relabelling (ref_frames.py), line 'mixed-planes', 20/30/40 GHz
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 of input power for every output mode

entries.component: WP1 Line with 10 m straights (paper section 7 sequence)
entries.card: WP1 acceptance: WP7's global-ODE reference for three lines
entries.reference: WP7 global-ODE reference, line 'long-straights' (21.4 m), 20/50/90 GHz
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 of input power for every output mode

entries.component: WP1 FrameChange
entries.card: WP1 acceptance: FrameChange is a signed permutation; H -> E -> H is the identity
entries.reference: relabelling derived from the potentials (ref_frames.py docstring), checked against quadrature and wrmodes.modes.eplane_frame_signs
entries.tolerance: exact

entries.component: WP7 surface-integral loss reference
entries.card: WP7
entries.reference: classical TE_mn / TM_mn attenuation formulas (Collin; Pozar eq. 3.96 for TE10)
entries.tolerance: 1e-9 relative (observed 2e-12)

entries.component: WP2 per-mode attenuation
entries.card: WP2 acceptance: lossy straight vs WP7 surface-integral reference
entries.reference: P_loss/(2P) with P_loss = (1/2) R_s oint |H_tan|^2 dl from transverse_field (ref_loss.py); WR-90 and 20 mm square, aluminium and copper; degenerate groups by eigenvalues of the wall-loss matrix
entries.tolerance: 1e-6 relative on alpha for every mode

entries.component: WP2 lossy Straight (all propagating modes)
entries.card: WP2 acceptance: lossy straight vs WP7 reference
entries.reference: WP7 first-order coupled system (own derivation = T1 B3-B4: all pairs through the walls, forward and backward blocks), solved by eigenmodes (ref_loss.first_order_matrices, straight_gsm_blocks); physics checked against exact Leontovich modes with one pair of impedance walls (ref_loss.one_pair_comparison)
entries.tolerance: 1e-8 absolute on S11 and S21 (implementation agreement); physical accuracy of the first-order model vs exact: 1e-3 (fc/f < 0.9), 2.5e-3 near cutoff
entries.status: reference ready; replaces the group-block comparison (docs/discrepancies/2026-11-08-wp2-wp7-straight-attenuation.md)

entries.component: WP3 Miter (H plane, diagonal miter c/a = 1)
entries.card: WP3 acceptance: H-plane miter vs Ma et al. 1997
entries.reference: Ma, Yamane & Yamashita, Electron. Commun. Jpn. 2, 80(5) (1997), Table 1, p. 5: 15.799 x 7.899 mm, 16 GHz, |S11| = 0.2622, |S21| = 0.9650
entries.tolerance: 0.57 % on |S11|, 0.04 % on |S21| (the spread the authors report under staircase displacement)

entries.component: WP3 Miter (H plane)

entries.component: Overmoded H-plane 90 deg optical-mirror miter (d/a = 1/sqrt(2)), TE10 power transmission, kd = 2 pi a/lambda = 10-31
entries.card: L2 (L1 item D8); used by WP3b, WP4b, WP7b
entries.reference: Kotik & Sivov, Radio Eng. Electron. Phys. 10 (1965) 140-142, Fig. 3: |B1|^2 vs kd, rigorous solution (truncated mode system, N <= 18)
entries.tolerance: the uncertainty column of each point (reading and the 0.005 drafting accuracy of the figure)
entries.status: reference ready (L2); text: 3 % loss at kd ~ 30 (figure: 0.971 at kd = 30); WP4b: rms z 1.30 over 416 points; outliers just above the TE40/TE60/TE80 cutoffs and -0.011 for kd > 30.4 (docs/reports/WP4b.md)

entries.component: Overmoded H-plane 90 deg optical-mirror miter, TE10 power transmission, large kd
entries.card: L2; used by WP7b
entries.reference: Katsenelenbaum (1963) as quoted by Kotik & Sivov (1965) p. 142: |B1|^2 = 1 - 7.4/(kd)^(3/2) (printed exponent 2/3 is a misprint), within 3 % (relative) of the rigorous solution for kd > 6 pi
entries.data_file: benchmarks/literature/kotik1965_fig3_asymptotic.csv (L2; the drawn curve, documents a drafting accuracy of 0.005 rms, 0.011 max)
entries.tolerance: 3 % relative for kd > 6 pi (the authors' statement)
